title: tropidia angulosa
intro: Tropidia angulosa, commonly known as the Angle-wing Orchid, is a species of orchid native to tropical Asia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tropidia angulosa include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Tropidia angulosa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
